'''Walter Salzburger''' (born 1 January 1975) is an Austrian-Swiss [[zoologist]] and [[evolutionary biologist]] and Professor at the Zoological Institute, Department of Environmental Sciences, of the [[University of Basel]] in Switzerland.<ref>{{Cite web| title=Curriculum Vitae - Walter Salzburger | url=http://www.salzburgerlab.org/media/uploads/_pages/team/walter_salzburger/_pdf/CV21.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220106184442/https://salzburgerlab.org/media/uploads/_pages/team/walter_salzburger/_pdf/CV21.pdf | archive-date=2022-01-06}}</ref>

== Work ==
The research of Walter Salzburger focuses on the understanding of organismal diversification in general and the evolutionary phenomena of adaptive radiation and explosive speciation in particular.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Salzburger |first1=Walter |date=2018 |title=Understanding explosive diversification through cichlid fish genomics |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/s41576-018-0043-9 |journal=Nature Reviews Genetics |volume=19 |issue=11 |pages=705–717 |doi=10.1038/s41576-018-0043-9 |pmid=30111830 |s2cid=256745378 |access-date= |name-list-style=vanc|url-access=subscription }}</ref> Salzburger's main organismal study systems are the exceptionally diverse adaptive radiations of [[cichlid]] fishes in East Africa, and in particular the cichlid fauna of [[Lake Tanganyika]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Muschick |first1=Moritz |last2=Indermaur |first2=Adrian |last3=Salzburger |first3=Walter |date=2012 |title=Convergent evolution within an adaptive radiation of cichlid fishes |url=https://www.cell.com/current-biology/pdf/S0960-9822(12)01269-9.pdf |journal=Current Biology |volume=22 |issue=24 |pages=2362–2368 |doi=10.1016/j.cub.2012.10.048 |pmid=23159601 |s2cid=18363916 |name-list-style=vanc}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Ronco |first1=Fabrizia |last2=Matschiner |first2=Michael |last3=Böhne |first3=Astrid |last4=Boila |first4=Anna |last5=Büscher |first5=Heinz |last6=El Taher |first6=Athimed |last7=Indermaur |first7=Adrian |last8=Malinsky |first8=Milan |last9=Ricci |first9=Virginie |last10=Kahmen |first10=Ansgar |last11=Jentoft |first11=Sissel |last12=Salzburger |first12=Walter |date=2021 |title=Drivers and dynamics of a massive adaptive radiation in cichlid fishes |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-020-2930-4 |journal=Nature |volume=589 |issue=24 |pages=76–81 |doi=10.1038/s41586-020-2930-4 |pmid=33208944 |bibcode=2021Natur.589...76R |s2cid=256820215 |name-list-style=vanc}}
</ref> In addition, his group has worked on vision in deep-sea fishes,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Musilova |first1=Zuzana |last2=Cortesi |first2=Fabio |last3=Matschiner |first3=Michael |last4=Davies |first4=Wayne I. L. |last5=Patel |first5=Jagdish Suresh |last6=Stieb |first6=Sara M. |last7=de Busserolles |first7=Fanny |last8=Malmstrøm |first8=Martin |last9=Tørresen |first9=Ole K. |last10=Brown |first10=Celeste J. |last11=Mountford |first11=Jessica K. |last12=Hanel |first12=Reinhold |last13=Stenkamp |first13=Deborah L. |last14=Jakobsen |first14=Kjetill S. |last15=Carleton |first15=Karen L. |last16=Jentoft |first16=Sissel |last17=Marshall |first17=Justin |last18=Salzburger |first18=Walter |date=2019 |title=Vision using multiple distinct rod opsins in deep-sea fishes |journal=Science |volume=364 |issue=6440 |pages=588–592 |doi=10.1126/science.aav4632 |pmid=31073066 |pmc=6628886 |bibcode=2019Sci...364..588M |name-list-style=vanc}}</ref> among many other topics.
